item.title: memories
item.description: had a profound remembrance today, doing what i had previously thought a mundane task and tried to think positively about during the last log. i suppose i regarded it as a trivial, time consuming thing with no potential of any intellectual benefit however, rendering out these item icons and many times re-rendering them, i remembered a very important factoid from college.

item.title: long time, no update
item.description: that is not to say there has not been progress. unfortunately development has taken a bit of a back seat to life circumstances, but is starting to get back on track.

item.title: data safety form complete
item.description: i managed to complete Google Play’s data safety form within a day, despite my initial expectations of its difficulty. in the end, it was just a matter of hunkering down and doing it.

item.title: creative angst
item.description: entered another phase of indecision shop system seems to work, although it still needs UI animation the gameplay itself also needs balancing; to address this i have begun leaning on my favorite pillar of design philosophy, research!
